resources.string:
1. Set defaults per action and file type: Android saves "Always" choices separately for each action and format. Tap "Test Open-With Prompt" below to trigger the chooser for "View Downloads" (select Wayfinder and tap "Always"); folders and each archive format (.zip, .tar.gz, .tgz, .tar) prompt the first time you open one from another app.

2. If the system Files app opens a folder, download, or archive without asking: Go to Android Settings → Apps → See all apps → Files → Open by default → Clear default preferences.

3. Change or reset anytime: You can change or remove Wayfinder's defaults at any time in Android Settings → Apps → Wayfinder → Open by default → Clear default preferences (or reopen this guide from ⋮ More → Default file handler…).
